title: The Illusion of Randomness: How LLMs Fail to Emulate Stochastic Decision-Making in Rock-Paper-Scissors Games?

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.1: 'GPT-4o-2024-08-06 (Hurst et al., 2024), GPT-4-turbo (Achiam et al., 2023), GPT-3.5-turbo'; 'temperature = 1, top-p = 1'; EMNLP Findings Nov 2025, no preview string.

prompt.location: Sec. 4.2 (RPS prompt box below Table 1); Appendix A.2 (game variants)
prompt.note: Footnote 2: RPS is spelled out as Rock-Paper-Scissors and {R,P,S} as Rock, Paper, Scissors in the real prompt.

claim.metric: mean total variation distance from the uniform 1/3 distribution (TVD)

data.source: No external dataset; the game prompt printed in Sec. 4.2 is the entire input; 100 independent single-turn games, new session per call

notes: Also runs o1-2024-12-17 (TVD 0.203) and o3-mini (0.647). The chosen action is read from the response. Alias 'GPT-4-turbo' resolved by the post-GA rule.
